en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. It was narrated to me by Muhammad b. al-Hassan from Muhammad b. al-Hassan al-Saffar from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah from Mansur b. al-Abbas from Sa’eed b. Janah who said it was narrated to me by Abu Mash’ar from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:
Alhamdulillaahi rabbil a’alameen four times every morning has without any doubt thanked for this day and one who says it in the night has thanked for that night.
